scope: One real native spawn_agent versus one Localoud CodexProvider independent worker; worker inference usage only

setup.task: Implement intervals.py: normalize(intervals), subtract(intervals,cuts), contains(intervals,point). Read policy.md for the exact interval policy before implementing. Implement a robust interval-set subtraction, normalization and membership utility using Python standard library. Add your own unit tests in test_intervals.py, run them and acceptance.py. All 9 fixed acceptance tests and your own edge-case tests must pass. Only edit intervals.py and test_intervals.py. Do not modify acceptance.py, policy.md or AGENTS.md. No delegation, network access, or unrelated project access. Work only in the assigned fixture directory. Report the changed files and validation results concisely.

limitations: One paired task, not a population estimate.
Native fork_turns=all inherits currently available parent context after compaction; this is not the entire historical transcript.
Task, policy and fixed tests match; system instructions, tool catalogs, history and warm caches differ between native Codex and the Localoud app-server.
Localoud exposes hub_context but both workers obtain this task policy from the same policy.md file. This tests independent worker dispatch, not a full planning/review workflow.
Native receives a path and authorization wrapper; Localoud receives the same task text with cwd set by the provider.
Parent orchestration, experiment preparation, ChatGPT planning/review and platform guardian usage are excluded. No full-session or subscription savings claim.
Localoud startup failure and the completed native result were retained; no model-run retry or best-of selection.
Wall time excludes Localoud compilation and startup; native wall time is spawn to final, so timing boundaries are approximate.
